bio_general: Johnny Boursiquot is a software engineer with over two decades of experience building and running production systems, on startup founding teams and inside large technology companies. He is co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of Skilltype, where he builds LLM-powered products, and he trains and advises engineering teams through his company, Idiomat. Earlier he helped establish Site Reliability Engineering practices at Heroku and contributed to O'Reilly's 97 Things Every SRE Should Know. His courses on Go, cloud, and AI engineering are available on O'Reilly, LinkedIn Learning, and Packt.
bio_go: Johnny Boursiquot is a multi-disciplined software engineer with a love for teaching and community-building. He founded the Baltimore Go User Group and has organized both the Boston Ruby and Boston Go user groups. He is a GopherCon program chair, delivered GopherCon closing keynotes in 2019 and 2021, and teaches workshops at GopherCon events in the US, Europe, and Singapore. He hosted the Go Time podcast from 2017 until its final episode in December 2024. He is co-founder and Chief Technology Officer of Skilltype.
approach: Much of my recent work is getting LLM-powered and agentic systems ready for production, which means explicit control flow, guardrails, and the same observability and testing any other service gets. Knowing how systems behave once real users arrive shapes most of the engineering decisions I make.
intro: I've built and run production systems on startup founding teams and inside large technology companies. I co-founded Skilltype and serve as its CTO. My work spans AI engineering, cloud architecture, and distributed systems, and I teach what I use through O'Reilly, LinkedIn Learning, Packt, and conference workshops.
about_1p: I'm a software engineer with over two decades of experience building and running production systems. These days I focus on AI engineering, cloud architecture, and distributed systems. Much of my recent work is getting LLM-powered and agentic systems ready for production, which means explicit control flow, guardrails, and the same observability and testing any other service gets.

I've been on several startup founding teams, including co-founding Skilltype, a cloud-based SaaS platform for workforce development, where I'm CTO. Along the way I was a Program Lead at Chick-fil-A and Director of Technology at Human Agency, and I helped establish site reliability engineering practices at Salesforce/Heroku. Knowing how systems behave once real users arrive shapes most of the engineering decisions I make.
I also speak and teach: conference keynotes, courses on O'Reilly and LinkedIn Learning, and years as a host of the Go Time podcast.

capabilities.name: AI Systems
capabilities.body: Designing and shipping production AI features, from RAG and tool calling to MCP integrations, on Bedrock, Anthropic, and OpenAI, with explicit control flow, guardrails, evaluation, and the same observability and testing as any other service.

capabilities.name: Cloud Architecture
capabilities.body: Designing and running cloud platforms for global user bases, from containers and serverless functions to event streams, queues, and infrastructure as code, with data handling built for privacy rules like GDPR.

capabilities.name: Reliability
capabilities.body: Incident command, SRE tooling, and release diagnostics, and instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, and Datadog so teams can see what production is doing.

capabilities.name: Distributed Systems
capabilities.body: Caching, event propagation, and distributed coordination for high-traffic workloads, plus time-series infrastructure and data stores from PostgreSQL and MySQL to DynamoDB and Redis.

capabilities.name: Security & Compliance
capabilities.body: Running SOC 2 readiness with automated security controls, vendor tracking, and audit evidence collection, and building GDPR-aware architecture, PII protection across vendors and regions, and TX-RAMP compliance into how products ship.

capabilities.name: Full-Stack Product Engineering
capabilities.body: Two decades of taking SaaS products from concept to production across enterprise software, loyalty and retail, education, and payments, owning everything from the React and TypeScript front end to the API, the data layer, and the deploy.

capabilities.name: Leadership
capabilities.body: Leading engineering as a CTO, director, and program lead: hiring and mentoring engineers, setting architecture, testing, and delivery standards, running SOC 2 and cost-control programs, and working with executives on what to build.
